data.resolution: Resolve exactly one record in the bound org; never publish runtime IDs

cases.objective: Read parent-authorized current policy and private history
steps: Authenticate as explicitly assigned integration persona
Resolve SYN-MM-O02 uniquely
GET with limit=20
Assert response schemaVersion exactly 1.1.0 and opportunity.id exactly matches the requested authorized parent
Assert every history item opportunityId matches that same requested parent, and no caller, owner or other user IDs are exposed
Assert USD, baseline-15, Pending Regional VP and history correlated only to the requested parent

cases.objective: Validate strict boundary oracles independent of runtime config
steps: GET SYN-MM-O03 and assert Not Required at exactly USD 50,000,000
GET SYN-MM-O04 and assert Not Required at exactly 15 percent
Do not modify either fixture
Authenticate as a persona without parent access
GET a known-but-inaccessible synthetic Opportunity
Assert uniform 404 with no record ID, stack trace or evidence values
Confirm direct Strategic_Deal_Evaluation__c query remains denied
GET with non-Opportunity ID and malformed ID
GET valid Opportunity with limits 0 and 51
Assert 400 INVALID_REQUEST and no data changes

cases.objective: Prove pagination bound and newest-first ordering
steps: Use an authorized per-run SYN-API fixture and create approved relevant-input changes through standard REST
GET with limit=1 then limit=50
Assert returned counts are bounded and newest evaluation matches persisted latest input
Verify unknown write outcomes before retry; retain fixture

cases.objective: Keep transport separate from business authority
steps: Assign only Strategic_Deal_API_Access to a minimum-access test identity in an isolated test transaction
Assert API/class transport does not grant Opportunity read or approval decision
Pair permissions only under the intended automation persona setup
